items.title: Freeze the document intent and capability audit contract
items.context: Compare global-lifecycle-control-plane-execution-plan.md and proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md against current CLI/source behavior. Produce a machine-checkable distinction between implemented, partial, future, and missing capabilities before development.

happy.desc: Run a local document/capability audit that classifies each frozen DoD capability as implemented, partial, future, or missing, and confirm the output cites the relevant docs and source/status evidence for every classification instead of collapsing partial/future/missing into one bucket.

edge.desc: Verify partially implemented capabilities remain marked partial when status commands expose some but not all required enforcement evidence, especially proofM7Enforcement, queueCleanupEnforcement, and tierCCleanup.

adversarial.desc: Reject an audit that treats command existence or zero exit status alone as implementation proof; evidence must include capability state, enforcement/readiness status, and source or doc references for the claim.

items.title: Reconcile Global Control Plane status reporting with documented gaps
items.context: Narrow this item to reporting/status reconciliation only: global_control_status and related projections must accurately expose implemented, partial, unavailable, and future capabilities, including proofM7Enforcement, queueCleanupEnforcement, and tierCCleanup. Runtime hard-block rollout, queue mutation guard, and proof admissibility enforcement remain owned by CHK-004, CHK-005, and CHK-006.

happy.desc: Run global_control_status as JSON and verify status reporting names the documented control-plane capabilities with accurate implemented, partial, unavailable, or future states, including proofM7Enforcement, queueCleanupEnforcement, and tierCCleanup.

edge.desc: Confirm status reporting stays reconciliation-only: proofM7Enforcement, queueCleanupEnforcement, and tierCCleanup may show partial or unavailable without implying CHK-004 hard-blocks, CHK-005 queue mutation guard, or CHK-006 admissibility enforcement have been completed.

adversarial.desc: Fail the item if global_control_status overclaims future or unavailable capabilities as enabled, or if dashboard/projection output hides documented gaps that remain open in the frozen DoD audit.

items.title: Register and verify Tier-C queue experiment exceptions
items.context: Make Tier-C provider-execution receipt verification stories group as experiment-batch-exception instead of ordinary duplicate-candidate while malformed entries remain cleanup-required. Exceptions must not waive lifecycle readiness.

items.title: Implement runtime closure hard-block rollout where safe
items.context: Move runtime closure from read-only projection to configured hard-blocks for unsafe operations such as wrong authoritative cwd, stale active locks, dirty phase-advance state, and worktree authority drift, with rollback/config documented.

items.title: Implement queue governance guard without destroying experiment evidence
items.context: Guard accidental duplicate/superseded mutations while preserving experiment batches and making malformed experiment records visible. Queue governance must not grant lifecycle completion.

items.title: Roll out proof admissibility enforcement for high-risk consumers
items.context: Close the Proof Admissibility M7 gap for configured high-risk consumers: DONE_REQUIRED, review assurance, handoff proof refs, and Authority-facing proof consumers. Keep diagnostic waterline read-only and do not overclaim productionDone.

items.title: Verify final delivery through ProofStory gates and document equivalence
items.context: Use proofstory_gate_check, intent_coverage_check, proofstory_review_completeness_check, done_intent_equivalence_check, delivery check, done-required validation, and 3x2 or explicit 3x1 review assurance to prove the final delivery covers the frozen document intent.
